title: owners.yaml
description: Per-service ownership fragment. Contributes path entries and label-owner blocks to the repository's generated CODEOWNERS file.

version.description: Schema version. Must match the version in .github/owners.config.yaml.

section.description: Routes every entry in this file to a named section of owners.config.yaml instead of the configured default section.

paths.description: Directories and files owned by this service.

label-owners.description: Who is notified for a set of issue labels. Blocks that declare the same label set are unioned across all fragments.

owner.description: A GitHub alias, or an Azure/<team> handle. Must have write access to the repository and public Azure org membership.

items.description: Must exist in the common label set: tools/github/data/common-labels.csv.

path.description: Relative to the directory containing this file. Use "." for that directory itself. Must not contain ".." and must not address anything outside this directory.

owners.description: Who reviews changes under this path. Teams expand to their members when owners are counted.

pr-labels.description: Labels applied to pull requests touching this path. Every label here must also be claimed by a label-owners block in this same file.

section.description: Routes this entry to a named section, overriding the file-level section.

labels.description: The label set this block owns. Used as the union key across fragments.

service-owners.description: Notified when an issue carries these labels.

azure-sdk-owners.description: Azure SDK team contacts for these labels.

section.description: Routes this entry to a named section, overriding the file-level section.
